answer: Blood pressure monitoring streak with clinic readings is the check: readings taken at one clinic every few months for years. A farm faking 549 aliases needs 549 separate reading streaks, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The violet test is the price tag: 549 fakes mean 549 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The island signal is visible to every grader, and the gale ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
